problems.statementHtml: How many integer values of \(x\) satisfy \(|x| < 3\pi?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 有多少个整数 \(x\) 满足 \(|x| < 3\pi\)？

problems.statementHtml: What is the value of \[ \begin{aligned} &\sqrt{\left(3-2\sqrt{3}\right)^2} \\ &{}+\sqrt{\left(3+2\sqrt{3}\right)^2}? \end{aligned} \]
problems.statementZhHtml: 下式的值是多少？\[ \begin{aligned} &\sqrt{\left(3-2\sqrt{3}\right)^2} \\ &{}+\sqrt{\left(3+2\sqrt{3}\right)^2} \end{aligned}\text{？}\]

problems.statementHtml: In an after-school program for juniors and seniors, there is a debate team with an equal number of students from each class on the team. Among the \(28\) students in the program, \(25\%\) of the juniors and \(10\%\) of the seniors are on the debate team. How many juniors are in the program?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在一个面向低年级和高年级学生的课后项目中，有一支辩论队，队中来自两个年级的学生人数相同。这个项目共有 \(28\) 名学生，其中 \(25\%\) 的低年级学生和 \(10\%\) 的高年级学生在辩论队中。这个项目中有多少名低年级学生？

problems.statementHtml: At a math contest, \(57\) students are wearing blue shirts, and another \(75\) students are wearing yellow shirts. The \(132\) students are assigned into \(66\) pairs. In exactly \(23\) of these pairs, both students are wearing blue shirts. In how many pairs are both students wearing yellow shirts?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在一场数学竞赛中，\(57\) 名学生穿蓝色衬衫，另外 \(75\) 名学生穿黄色衬衫。这 \(132\) 名学生被分成 \(66\) 对。其中恰有 \(23\) 对中两名学生都穿蓝色衬衫。有多少对中两名学生都穿黄色衬衫？

problems.statementHtml: The ages of Jonie’s four cousins are distinct single-digit positive integers. Two of the cousins’ ages multiplied together give \(24,\) while the other two multiply to \(30.\) What is the sum of the ages of Jonie’s four cousins?
problems.statementZhHtml: Jonie 的四个表亲年龄互不相同，且都是一位正整数。其中两个表亲的年龄相乘为 \(24\)，另外两个相乘为 \(30\)。Jonie 的四个表亲年龄之和是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Ms. Blackwell gives an exam to two classes. The mean of the scores of the students in the morning class is \(84,\) and the afternoon class’s mean score is \(70.\) The ratio of the number of students in the morning class to the number of students in the afternoon class is \(\frac{3}{4}.\) What is the mean of the scores of all the students?
problems.statementZhHtml: Blackwell 老师给两个班考试。上午班学生的平均分是 \(84\)，下午班学生的平均分是 \(70\)。上午班人数与下午班人数之比为 \(\frac{3}{4}\)。所有学生的平均分是多少？

problems.statementHtml: In a plane, four circles with radii \(1,\) \(3,\) \(5,\) and \(7\) are tangent to line \(\ell\) at the same point \(A,\) but they may be on either side of \(\ell.\) Region \(S\) consists of all the points that lie inside exactly one of the four circles. What is the maximum possible area of region \(S?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 在平面中，半径分别为 \(1\)、\(3\)、\(5\) 和 \(7\) 的四个圆都与直线 \(\ell\) 在同一点 \(A\) 相切，但它们可以位于 \(\ell\) 的任一侧。区域 \(S\) 由恰好位于这四个圆中一个圆内部的所有点组成。区域 \(S\) 的最大可能面积是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Mr. Zhou places all the integers from \(1\) to \(225\) into a \(15\) by \(15\) grid. He places \(1\) in the middle square (eighth row and eighth column) and places other numbers one by one clockwise, as shown in part in the diagram below. What is the sum of the greatest number and the least number that appear in the second row from the top?
problems.statementZhHtml: Zhou 先生把从 \(1\) 到 \(225\) 的所有整数放入一个 \(15\) 行 \(15\) 列的方格中。他把 \(1\) 放在正中间的方格（第八行第八列），然后如图所示按顺时针方向逐个放入其他数。在从上往下数第二行中出现的最大数与最小数之和是多少？

problems.statementHtml: The point \(P(a,b)\) in the \(xy\)-plane is first rotated counterclockwise by \(90^\circ\) around the point \((1,5)\) and then reflected about the line \(y = -x.\) The image of \(P\) after these two transformations is at \((-6,3).\) What is \(b - a ?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: \(xy\) 平面中的点 \(P(a,b)\) 先绕点 \((1,5)\) 逆时针旋转 \(90^\circ\)，再关于直线 \(y = -x\) 反射。经过这两个变换后，\(P\) 的像为 \((-6,3)\)。\(b - a \) 等于多少？

problems.statementHtml: An inverted cone with base radius \(12 \mathrm{ cm}\) and height \(18 \mathrm{ cm}\) is full of water. The water is poured into a tall cylinder whose horizontal base has a radius of \(24 \mathrm{ cm}.\) What is the height in centimeters of the water in the cylinder?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个倒置的圆锥底面半径为 \(12 \mathrm{ cm}\)，高为 \(18 \mathrm{ cm}\)，里面装满了水。把水倒入一个高圆柱中，圆柱的水平底面半径为 \(24 \mathrm{ cm}\)。圆柱中水的高度是多少厘米？

problems.statementHtml: Grandma has just finished baking a large rectangular pan of brownies. She is planning to make rectangular pieces of equal size and shape, with straight cuts parallel to the sides of the pan. Each cut must be made entirely across the pan. Grandma wants to make the same number of interior pieces as pieces along the perimeter of the pan. What is the greatest possible number of brownies she can produce?
problems.statementZhHtml: 奶奶刚烤好一大盘长方形布朗尼。她打算沿着盘子的边平行地直线切开，做成大小和形状相同的长方形小块。每一刀都必须从盘子的一边完全切到另一边。奶奶希望内部小块的数量与位于周边的小块数量相同。她最多可以做出多少块布朗尼？

problems.statementHtml: Let \(N = 34 \cdot 34 \cdot 63 \cdot 270.\) What is the ratio of the sum of the odd divisors of \(N\) to the sum of the even divisors of \(N?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \(N = 34 \cdot 34 \cdot 63 \cdot 270\)。\(N\) 的奇因数之和与 \(N\) 的偶因数之和的比是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Let \(n\) be a positive integer and \(d\) be a digit such that the value of the numeral \(\underline{32d}\) in base \(n\) equals \(263,\) and the value of the numeral \(\underline{324}\) in base \(n\) equals the value of the numeral \(\underline{11d1}\) in base six. What is \(n + d ?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \(n\) 是正整数，\(d\) 是一个数字。以 \(n\) 为底的数 \(\underline{32d}\) 的值等于 \(263\)，并且以 \(n\) 为底的数 \(\underline{324}\) 的值等于以六为底的数 \(\underline{11d1}\) 的值。\(n + d \) 等于多少？

problems.statementHtml: Three equally spaced parallel lines intersect a circle, creating three chords of lengths \(38,\) \(38,\) and \(34.\) What is the distance between two adjacent parallel lines?
problems.statementZhHtml: 三条等距平行线与一个圆相交，形成三条长度分别为 \(38\)、\(38\) 和 \(34\) 的弦。相邻两条平行线之间的距离是多少？

problems.statementHtml: The real number \(x\) satisfies the equation \[x+\frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{5}.\] What is the value of \(x^{11}-7x^{7}+x^3?\)

Call a positive integer an uphill integer if every digit is strictly greater than the previous digit. For example, \(1357,\) \(89,\) and \(5\) are all uphill integers, but \(32,\) \(1240,\) and \(466\) are not. How many uphill integers are divisible by \(15?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 如果一个正整数的每一位数字都严格大于前一位数字，则称它为上坡整数。例如 \(1357\)，\(89\) 和 \(5\) 都是上坡整数，但 \(32\)，\(1240\) 和 \(466\) 不是。多少个上坡整数能被 \(15\) 整除？

problems.statementHtml: Ravon, Oscar, Aditi, Tyrone, and Kim play a card game. Each person is given \(2\) cards out of a set of \(10\) cards numbered \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) \(\dots,\) \(10.\) The score of a player is the sum of the numbers of their cards. The scores of the players are as follows: Ravon--\(11,\) Oscar--\(4,\) Aditi--\(7,\) Tyrone--\(16,\) Kim--\(17.\) Which of the following statements is true?
problems.statementZhHtml: Ravon、Oscar、Aditi、Tyrone 和 Kim 玩一个纸牌游戏。每人从编号 \(1\)，\(2\)，\(3\)，\(\dots\)，\(10\) 的 \(10\) 张牌中拿到 \(2\) 张。玩家的得分是自己两张牌上数字之和。五人的得分如下：Ravon 为 \(11\)，Oscar 为 \(4\)，Aditi 为 \(7\)，Tyrone 为 \(16\)，Kim 为 \(17\)。下列哪项陈述正确？

problems.statementHtml: A fair \(6\)-sided die is repeatedly rolled until an odd number appears. What is the probability that every even number appears at least once before the first occurrence of an odd number?
problems.statementZhHtml: 反复掷一枚公平的 \(6\) 面骰，直到第一次出现奇数为止。在第一次出现奇数之前，每个偶数都至少出现一次的概率是多少？

problems.statementHtml:
Suppose that \(S\) is a finite set of positive integers.

If the greatest integer in \(S\) is removed from \(S,\) then the average value (arithmetic mean) of the integers remaining is \(32.\) If the least integer in \(S\) is also removed, then the average value of the integers remaining is \(35.\) If the greatest integer is then returned to the set, the average value of the integers rises to \(40.\) The greatest integer in the original set \(S\) is \(72\) greater than the least integer in \(S.\)

What is the average value of all the integers in the set \(S?\)
problems.statementZhHtml:
设 \(S\) 是一个有限的正整数集合。

如果从 \(S\) 中移除 \(S\) 中最大的整数，剩余整数的平均值为 \(32\)。如果再从 \(S\) 中移除最小的整数，剩余整数的平均值为 \(35\)。如果随后把最大的整数放回 \(S\)，平均值升高到 \(40\)。原集合 \(S\) 中最大的整数比最小的整数大 \(72\)。

集合 \(S\) 中所有整数的平均值是多少？

problems.statementHtml: The figure below is constructed from \(11\) line segments, each of which has length \(2.\) The area of pentagon \(ABCDE\) can be written as \(\sqrt{m} + \sqrt{n},\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are positive integers. What is \(m + n ?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 下图由 \(11\) 条线段构成，每条线段长度都为 \(2\)。五边形 \(ABCDE\) 的面积可写成 \(\sqrt{m} + \sqrt{n}\)，其中 \(m\) 和 \(n\) 为正整数。\(m + n \) 等于多少？

problems.statementHtml: A square piece of paper has side length \(1\) and vertices \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) and \(D\) in that order. As shown in the figure, the paper is folded so that vertex \(C\) meets edge \(\overline{AD}\) at point \(C',\) and edge \(\overline{BC}\) intersects edge \(\overline{AB}\) at point \(E.\) Suppose that \(C'D = \frac{1}{3}.\) What is the perimeter of \(\triangle AEC'?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 一张正方形纸片边长为 \(1\)，顶点按顺序为 \(A\)，\(B\)，\(C\) 和 \(D\)。如图所示，将纸片折叠，使顶点 \(C\) 落在边 \(\overline{AD}\) 上的点 \(C'\)，且边 \(\overline{BC}\) 与边 \(\overline{AB}\) 相交于点 \(E\)。若 \(C'D = \frac{1}{3}\)，三角形 \(\triangle AEC'\) 的周长是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Ang, Ben, and Jasmin each have \(5\) blocks, colored red, blue, yellow, white, and green; and there are \(5\) empty boxes. Each of the people randomly and independently of the other two people places one of their blocks into each box. The probability that at least one box receives \(3\) blocks all of the same color is \(\frac{m}{n},\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(m + n ?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: Ang、Ben 和 Jasmin 每人都有 \(5\) 块积木，颜色分别为红、蓝、黄、白、绿；另有 \(5\) 个空盒子。三个人各自随机且彼此独立地把自己的每种颜色积木各放入一个盒子中。至少有一个盒子收到 \(3\) 块同色积木的概率为 \(\frac{m}{n}\)，其中 \(m\) 与 \(n\) 是互质正整数。\(m + n \) 等于多少？

problems.statementHtml: A square with side length \(8\) is colored white except for \(4\) black isosceles right triangular regions with legs of length \(2\) in each corner of the square and a black diamond with side length \(2\sqrt{2}\) in the center of the square, as shown in the diagram. A circular coin with diameter \(1\) is dropped onto the square and lands in a random location where the coin is completely contained within the square. The probability that the coin will cover part of the black region of the square can be written as \(\frac{1}{196}\left(a+b\sqrt{2}+\pi\right),\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are positive integers. What is \(a+b?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个边长为 \(8\) 的正方形中，除了 \(4\) 个角上腿长为 \(2\) 的阴影等腰直角三角形，以及正方形中心一个边长为 \(2\sqrt{2}\) 的阴影菱形外，其余部分都不涂阴影，如图所示。 一枚直径为 \(1\) 的圆形硬币落到正方形上，并随机落在一个使硬币完全包含在正方形内的位置。硬币覆盖到正方形阴影区域一部分的概率可写成 \(\frac{1}{196}\left(a+b\sqrt{2}+\pi\right)\)，其中 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 是正整数。\(a+b\) 等于多少？

problems.statementHtml: Arjun and Beth play a game in which they take turns removing one brick or two adjacent bricks from one “wall” among a set of several walls of bricks, with gaps possibly creating new walls. The walls are one brick tall. For example, a set of walls of sizes \(4\) and \(2\) can be changed into any of the following by one move: \((3,2),\) \((2,1,2),\) \((4),\) \((4,1),\) \((2,2),\) or \((1,1,2).\) Arjun plays first, and the player who removes the last brick wins. For which starting configuration is there a strategy that guarantees a win for Beth?
problems.statementZhHtml: Arjun 和 Beth 玩一个游戏：他们轮流从若干堵砖墙中的一堵移除一块砖，或移除相邻的两块砖；移除后产生的空隙可能把一堵墙分成新的墙。每堵墙都只有一块砖高。例如，大小为 \(4\) 和 \(2\) 的一组墙，经过一步可以变成以下任意一种：\((3,2)\)，\((2,1,2)\)，\((4)\)，\((4,1)\)，\((2,2)\)，或 \((1,1,2)\)。 Arjun 先手，移除最后一块砖的玩家获胜。对于哪一种初始配置，Beth 有必胜策略？

problems.statementHtml: Let \(S\) be the set of lattice points in the coordinate plane, both of whose coordinates are integers between \(1\) and \(30,\) inclusive. Exactly \(300\) points in \(S\) lie on or below a line with equation \(y=mx.\) The possible values of \(m\) lie in an interval of length \(\frac ab,\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(a+b?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \(S\) 是坐标平面中的格点集合，其中两个坐标都是从 \(1\) 到 \(30\) 的整数。恰有 \(300\) 个 \(S\) 中的点位于直线 \(y=mx\) 上或其下方。所有可能的 \(m\) 值构成一个长度为 \(\frac ab\) 的区间，其中 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 是互质正整数。\(a+b\) 等于多少？
